description.en: Returns one setting of a camera. Names: "Fov" (field of view, in degrees), "Stereo", "Smooth" (1 on, 0 off), "DepthLevel" and "DepthRange" (depth-of-field settings, see CMND_DEPTHLEVEL_FADE and CMND_DEPTHRANGE_FADE).

The value: a float for Fov, Stereo, DepthLevel and DepthRange; for Smooth, 1 when on and 0 when off.
null if the camera is not found, the name is unknown, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Saving the depth of field before a talk (real usage, from ie4_ev_main.nut)
